beats.name: hook
beats.said: A man brakes hard on a highway and the car behind crashes into him.
beats.shown: Grinning driver in car interior, then red car on highway rear-ended by a white SUV.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: He fakes a neck injury, insurance pays for car, doctor and pain money.
beats.shown: Driver and other man on road, lawn with hospital bed and cash.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: He repeats it with chosen targets, adds a buddy, buys nicer cars to crash.
beats.shown: Dusk traffic with red/teal cars, money piles, green sports car smoking.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: Insurance notices five neck injuries; he claims a weak neck and counts on blame.
beats.shown: Insurance clerk at desk, man in pool on phone, night lawn with officer.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: On a rainy morning a quiet driver just points at a taped box.
beats.shown: Rainy dashboard POVs, quiet driver pointing at a camera, falling yellow man, sweating close-up.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: The camera filmed an empty road and braking for nothing; thus the dashcam.
beats.shown: Dashcam footage with REC and speed overlay, then quiet driver beside camera on glass.

hook.first_frame: Cartoon driver in yellow shirt seated at the wheel, smirking sideways, in a detailed 3D car interior with a phone in the foreground.
hook.first_3s: Grin widens, camera swoops from interior out to a red car on the highway, then a white SUV rams it.
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title states the question of why drivers film the road; the first line starts the story with the brake-check crash and never repeats the title.

story.real_fact_core: Staged rear-end collision insurance fraud (brake-checking) is exposed by video evidence, which is why dashcams spread (estimate).
story.authority_or_antagonist: Insurance clerk, then the quiet driver with dashcam

tone.humour: Absurd escalation: money piles, buying cars to crash, weak-neck excuse.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Flat clerk and deadpan quiet driver contrast the scammer's grin; final reveal is understated.
tone.dialogue_style: Two short lines of spoken dialogue in the same narrator voice; no separate voices (estimate from transcript).
